jobs.title: Junior Recruiter (Jogja)
jobs.description: As a Junior Recruiter at KitaLulus, you will support end-to-end talent sourcing by identifying, engaging, and screening potential candidates for our client partners. Key Responsibility: a. Use LinkedIn, specialized databases, and creative sourcing methods to find candidates who aren't even looking for a job. b. Reach out to potential candidates and "sell" the vision of our client partners. c. Conduct initial interviews to assess if a candidate has the "right stuff" beyond just a resume. d. Pipeline Management: Keep our database clean and ensure no great candidate falls through the cracks. e. Research industries to understand who the movers and shakers are in specific sectors. Job Requirements: a. You can talk to anyone, from a junior dev to a C-suite executive, with confidence and clarity. b. Headhunting involves a lot of "nos" before you get to the "yes." You have thick skin and a positive outlook. c. You love learning how different businesses work and what makes a person successful in their career. d. 0-2 years of experience. (We are more than happy to welcome fresh graduates who bring high energy and a great attitude to the team) e. Comfortable using English for daily communication and in professional setting (written and verbal).
